overview: The Naples conference ran from 8 to 12 July 2024 at the Accademia Pontaniana. The booklet lists 20 scheduled plenary talks, alongside a poster programme. Themes include shifted and derived geometry, groupoids, quantization, moduli spaces, dynamics and mathematical physics. The timetable places the poster buffet on Wednesday 10 July.

highlights.text: Yunhe Sheng’s slides connect post-groups and post-groupoids with Rota–Baxter operators, braces, Butcher groups and Yang–Baxter equations. The title page records 10 July 2024.
Henrique Bursztyn’s handwritten slides present symplectic groupoids through 2-shifted Lagrangian structures and credit joint work with D. Álvarez and M. Cueca.

overview: The 12th international Poisson conference took place on 25–29 July 2022. Its booklet describes a joint CRM–ICMAT intensive research programme, with an advanced school in Barcelona preceding the Madrid conference. The schedule distinguishes the opening day at ICMAT from the following days at the CSIC Central Building. The programme includes Hamiltonian spaces, quantization, symplectic foliations, Lie groupoids and algebroids.

overview: The 11th international edition met in Toronto on 16–20 July 2018. The programme includes plenary talks on symplectic foliations, deformation quantization, Dirac geometry and Poisson–Lie theory. The official record lists a reception and poster session at the Fields Institute and identifies Brent Pym and Chelsea Walton as the 2018 Lichnerowicz Prize recipients.
